newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moslem rebels kill six Algerian civilians.
newsitem.headline: Moslem rebels kill six Algerian civilians.

text.p: Moslem fundamentalists killed six civilians overnight in the Algiers suburb of Baraki, Algerian security forces said on Tuesday.

In a statement issued by the official Algerian news agency, they said "the six civilians were killed overnight by a group of terrorists", but gave no other details. The security forces usually refer to Moslem fundamentalist radicals as terrorists.
